privacy-text-approved.what: The privacy policy's final text is written by UX & PM, approved by Vitor, and every claim in it matches what the system enforces today (W3).

terms-text-approved.what: The terms of use's final text is written by UX & PM and approved by Vitor (W3).

delete-account-live.what: Me → Delete account (type DELETE, confirm) works in a RELEASED app build and on the live web journal, and deletes every row plus the auth user immediately (M7 + the web Me screen).

backup-retention.what: Supabase backups are kept 8 days: the prod list holds today + 7 back (decisions 44 + 84, checked by Mobile Dev); BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS in src/lib/site.ts = 8. Deleted data disappears from backups within that window.

web-journal-live.what: The signed-in web journal (W0 shell + onboarding + Today, at parity with the released app) is live for users, with Vitor's go. Gates /app, /sign-in, /forgot-password and the "Continue on the web" button.

ai-memory.what: The AI memory screen (Me → What Moodbow remembers: see, edit, delete facts) is live on the app and the web (R2).

purchases.what: AI credit purchases (Google Play / App Store) are live, with the refund rule enforced (R2).

app-lock.what: The app lock (1.1, decision 174) is in a RELEASED app build. App-only: on the web it only gates the Help article that explains it.

share-cards.what: Share cards (made on the device, leaving it only when the user shares) are in a RELEASED app build and on the web (M10).

ai-live.what: AI reflections and reports are switched on for users (the AI flag on, decision D2), with the free Lite allowance enforced server-side.

starter-credits.what: New accounts get starter credits after confirming their email (app_config.starter_credits > 0, enforced server-side). Flips with ai-live (the same AI go-live day: starter credits only mean something with AI; UX).

export-live.what: Me → Export my data (JSON + readable text, everything the user created) works in a RELEASED app build and on the live web journal (M7).

help-now-live.what: Me → Get help now (the safety card with local hotlines from the country registry) is in a RELEASED app build and on the live web journal (M7 + M8).

web-analytics.what: Vercel Web Analytics (cookie-free visit counts, decision 79) is enabled for the moodbow-web project by Vitor in Vercel. Flipping this shows the privacy policy's visit-count lines and loads the counter (with the URL scrubber, src/lib/analytics.ts) in the same deploy.

timeline-moments-rpc.what: get_timeline(p_before, p_limit, p_moments_only) from moodbow-app migration 005 is applied on PRODUCTION (Mobile Dev confirms; staging has it since 2026-10-19). Until then the Timeline's Moments filter shows on Previews only.

offline-start.what: The app opens without a connection for a user who signed in before, showing the journal saved on the phone (the app's offline start, Mobile Dev). Gates the Help article line about it.

reminder-live.what: The daily reminder is in a RELEASED app build (local notification at the chosen time, skipped if that phone saw a check-in that day). Gates the Help article about reminders.

share-cards-more.what: 1.1 B (decision 169): the chart and milestone share cards and Today's milestone card are tested on the app and the web (needs share-cards too).

on-this-day-live.what: 1.1 A "On this day" (specs/1.1-features.md) is tested on both the app and the web; then the Timeline card shows on Production (UX: not tied to a release, may be in time for 1.0).

shortcuts-live.what: 1.1 O web keyboard shortcuts (decision 200, specs/1.1-features.md §O) are tested on the web: then the shortcuts, the ? list and the Me → Appearance switch (WCAG 2.1.4) are on for Production, with their Help article (keyboard-shortcuts.md). Never before search-live: the article mentions "/" for search (UX; conditions.test enforces it). Shown on Previews before that.

export-csv-live.what: 1.1 P spreadsheet export (decision 201, specs/1.1-features.md §P) is tested on the web, including the round trip into a fresh account: then Me → Export my data offers the .csv on Production, with its Help line. Shown on Previews before that.

search-live.what: 1.1 L search (decision 195) is tested on the web (and the app's own, for parity): then the Timeline's magnifier shows on Production. Shown on Previews before that.

calendar-live.what: 1.1 M month calendar (decision 197, specs/1.1-features.md §M) is tested on the web: then Timeline's List · Calendar switch shows on Production. Shown on Previews before that.

print-live.what: 1.1 N "Print this month" (decision 199, specs/1.1-features.md §N, web only) is tested on the web, and /app/print/YYYY-MM is scrubbed to [date] in Sentry (#90): then the Timeline's print links and /app/print show on Production. Shown on Previews before that.

csp-enforced.what: The Content-Security-Policy (lib/csp.ts) is enforced instead of Report-Only. Flip only after a clean Preview run of every page (journal, share-card canvas, the OG route) with no violations reported to Sentry (reviewer's audit A1).

weekly-report-live.what: 1.1 D "Your week" (specs/m9-weekly-report.md, decision 180) is tested on the app and the web against staging; then the Insights card shows on Production, which also needs AI live there (the combined AI go-live).

widget-live.what: The home-screen widget (1.1 E) is in a RELEASED app build (Android first). App-only: on the web it only gates the Help article that explains it.

writing-prompts.what: 1.1 I writing prompts (decision 183): the quiet prompt above an empty entry, from contracts/prompts.json, is tested on the app and the web.

year-card.what: 1.1 J "My year's moodbow" (decision 184): the Year card in the share sheet (December and January, ≥ 3 coloured months) is tested on the app and the web (needs share-cards too).

play-live.what: The Play listing is public (Vitor). Then the web shows the Google Play link (decision 185) and the manifest names the app (related_applications).

appstore-live.what: The App Store listing is public (Vitor), and src/lib/stores.ts has its URL and id. Then the web shows the App Store link and the iOS smart app banner (decision 185).

import-live.what: 1.1 K import from another journal (decision 189: Daylio + generic CSV, web first) is tested on the web; then Me → Your data offers it on Production.
